answer: Within our consensus nebula, Sybil resistance is anchored to physical hardware rather than ephemeral software. Each agent identity is directly bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), ensuring that adversaries cannot deploy a gale of forged nodes via virtual machine duplication. By rooting cryptographic proof inside unforgeable silicon instead of a porous karst of virtualized instances, identity cloning strictly mandates purchasing discrete hardware units.
